KEN.note: Draft tax regulations list AI services as taxable; no AI harm rule or authority stated.
Nothing on government use of AI.
Nothing on AI in a public sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in Kenya.

facts.fact: The National Treasury and Kenya Revenue Authority published the draft Income Tax (Significant Economic Presence Tax) Regulations, 2025 as a draft for public participation.
facts.system: Income Tax (Significant Economic Presence Tax) Regulations, 2025 (draft)
